accounts.name: Name
accounts.creditHelpIntro: Total limit = bank maximum. Amount owed = balance due on posted purchases (statement). Available credit = Total limit − Amount owed (Nexus calculates this when you buy).
accounts.creditLimitHint: Authorized ceiling; not what you owe or what is available.
accounts.owedHelp: Not available credit. What you owe on posted purchases (statement balance).
accounts.helpOwedHtml: Not available credit. What you owe on posted purchases (statement balance). Example: $10M limit and $3M owed → enter 3,000,000 here; Nexus shows ~$7M available for new purchases.
accounts.helpVirtualHtml: Positive = balance in your favor. Negative = debt in the app. Credit limit goes in the purple section below.
accounts.helpInvestmentHtml: Capital invested in this vault today (not debt).

settings.languageHint: Translates all native app UI. Your manual income/expense entries are never translated: notes, custom categories, and amounts you entered.
settings.auditPageSizeHint: Only how many rows render at once. Totals and exports always use the full filter.
